unsynced_ctrl.ShowLoadProgress.reason: No Lua equivalent: shows a progress line on the loading screen and redraws it during a module's own long loading step. Its only effect is what the loading screen draws, and outside loading it does nothing, so there is no state to compare between native and Wasm.

gfx.QueryCounter.reason: No Lua equivalent: glQueryCounter(GL_TIMESTAMP) into a CreateQuery handle. The value is a GPU clock reading that differs per run and machine, so there is nothing to compare between native and Wasm beyond the handle lookup it shares with GetQuery.
